verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago is a payments API platform, so scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no permission scopes, restricted keys, or per-agent credential issuance. The only credential mention describes one token that operates payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores, and reports, which is broad access rather than least-privilege scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
